declarations.type:
∀ {f df k k' : ℝ → ℂ} {a b u : ℝ},
  0 ≤ a →
    a < b →
      b < u →
        MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn f (Set.Ioo 0 u) MeasureTheory.volume →
          MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun r => ↑r * df r) (Set.Ioo 0 u) MeasureTheory.volume →
            (∀ (δ : ℝ), 0 < δ → MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn df (Set.Ioo δ u) MeasureTheory.volume) →
              (∀ (η : ℝ → ℝ),
                  ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) η →
                    HasCompactSupport η →
                      tsupport η ⊆ Set.Ioo 0 u → ∫ (t : ℝ), ↑(deriv η t) * f t = -∫ (t : ℝ), ↑(η t) * df t) →
                (∀ (x : ℝ), HasDerivAt k (k' x) x) →
                  Continuous k' →
                    ∫ (x : ℝ) in Set.Icc a b,
                        df x * (↑x * k x) + f x * (k x + ↑x * k' x) -
                            ↑b * k b * (↑(1 / (b - a)) * f x + ↑((x - a) / (b - a)) * df x) -
                          ↑a * k a * (↑(1 / (a - b)) * f x + ↑((x - b) / (a - b)) * df x) =

                ∫ (w : (ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ × ℝ),

  IsOpen U →

        ContDiffOn ℝ 1 W₂ U →
          (∀ x ∈ U, HasDerivAt (fun t => W₁ (t, x.2)) (D₁ x) x.1) →
